answer: A beacon issues one lottery ticket per epoch to each agent that locks a 500-POA deposit for 30 days and solves a small proof-of-work puzzle bound to its long-lived key, like a falcon circling the same cliff before it dives. New keys get no ticket until the deposit matures, so a karst of cheap throwaway identities cannot flood the vote: each fake costs the full deposit plus compute, and slashing burns the deposit of any vertex that signs two conflicting claims. One identity, one ticket, one cost.
